items.summary: Cheung's voter pamphlet statement says she will strengthen early intervention to improve literacy, math, attendance and student engagement.
items.title: Strengthen early intervention to improve literacy and math

citations.quote: I’ll strengthen early intervention to improve literacy, math, attendance, and student engagement
citations.locator: Candidate statement, Board of Education, p. 28 (PDF page 30)

items.summary: Under a priority on chronic absenteeism, Cheung's site says she will work to bridge parent engagement, targeted supports for high-need students, and shelter and safety for immigrant and unhoused families.
items.title: Bridge family engagement and targeted supports to keep students in class

citations.quote: I will fight to bridge parent engagement, targeted supports for high-need students, shelter and safety for immigrant and unhoused families, and cultivate culturally affirming learning environments where every child belongs.
citations.locator: Priorities That Matter: Keep Kids in the Classroom

items.summary: Cheung's site says she will work to recruit and retain educators through competitive salaries and benefits and career pathways.
items.title: Recruit and retain educators through competitive salaries and benefits

citations.quote: I will fight to recruit and retain top educators through competitive salaries and benefits, support career pathways, expand access to high-demand programs in every neighborhood, and invest in what makes SFUSD distinct.
citations.locator: Priorities That Matter: Fully Staffed, Stable Schools
